description: This file is the entry point for a React frontend application. It initializes the React app by rendering the 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It also imports necessary dependencies such as React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the created root, initializing the app's component hierarchy.
